title: Reign of the Seven Dragon Sovereigns
dateDisplay: ~7,000+ Years Ago • The Primordial Light Realm
summary: Before the arrival of gods or humanity, Teyvat was an untamed elemental realm ruled exclusively by seven colossal dragon sovereigns.
description: In the ancient age of the Light Realm, the Seven Dragon Sovereigns held supreme dominion over the primordial elements of Teyvat. Under the leadership of the Dragon King Nibelung, civilizations of vishaps and dragons flourished across the globe without celestial interference or divine thrones.

sources.title: Before Sun and Moon: When the Doves Held Branches
sources.quote: In the beginning, the world was ruled by the dragons. The dragons held the primordial elemental authority.

sources.title: Neuvillette - Character Story 5
sources.quote: Severed from the primordial throne, the authority of the dragons was wrested away by the usurper.

title: Nibelung's Cosmic Journey & The Power from Beyond
dateDisplay: ~6,500+ Years Ago • Cosmic Incursion
summary: Dragon King Nibelung travels beyond Teyvat's firmament, returning with dark forbidden power to fight celestial invaders.
description: Foreshadowing the arrival of extraterrestrial powers, Dragon King Nibelung ventured outside the boundary of Teyvat into the Dark Sea and the cosmos. He acquired a pitch-black power from beyond this world to contest celestial invaders, planting the first seeds of the forbidden knowledge that would later plague the world.

sources.title: Apep - Dialogue in The Realm of Beginnings
sources.quote: The Dragon King acquired the power of darkness from outside of this world and led us in a rebellion against the order established by the invaders.

title: Genesis of Morax (Rex Lapis)
dateDisplay: >6,000 Years Ago • Genesis of the Prime Adeptus
summary: Morax emerges as a primeval god of Geo and Prime Adeptus, beginning his vigil over the lands of Liyue.
description: Over six thousand years ago, before the establishment of nations and long before the Archon War, Morax took physical form as a primeval deity with dominion over earth and stone. As the Prime of Adepti, he would eventually lead gods and mortals through millennia of turmoil to build Liyue.

sources.title: Zhongli - Character Story 5 & Voice Lines
sources.quote: I have lived for over six thousand years. The journey has been long, and time wears away at all things.

sources.title: Stone Tablet Compilations: Vol. 1
sources.quote: The Geo Lord was born from the raw essence of mountain stone, walking the untamed earth before the kingdoms rose.

title: Arrival of Phanes & Creation of the Four Shades
dateDisplay: ~6,000 Years Ago • Creation of Heaven and Earth
summary: The Primordial One (Phanes) arrives in Teyvat and creates Four Shining Shades to reshape the cosmos.
description: Born from an egg and crowned with wings, the Primordial One (Phanes) descended upon Teyvat as the First Descender. Phanes created four shining shades from itself, including the Shade of Time (Istaroth), the Shade of Death, the Shade of Life, and the Shade of Space, preparing to seize control of the world from the native dragons.

sources.title: Before Sun and Moon: On Phanes, or The Primordial One
sources.quote: The Primordial One may have been Phanes. It had wings and a crown, and was born from an egg, neither male nor female... Phanes brought forth four shining shades of itself.

sources.title: Genshin Impact Wiki: The Primordial One

title: The Forty-Year War: Fall of the Dragon Sovereigns
dateDisplay: ~5,960 Years Ago • Subjugation of the Sovereigns
summary: Phanes and the Four Shades wage a forty-year war against the Seven Dragons, shattering their dominion.
description: A titanic conflict erupted between the Primordial One and the Seven Dragon Sovereigns. The war lasted for forty long years, violently reshaping Teyvat's landscapes and elements. In the end, the dragon kings were defeated, their absolute authority over the elements fractured, and the survivors fled to the depths or went into hiding.

sources.title: Before Sun and Moon: The Forty-Year War
sources.quote: Forty winters mourned, and forty springs were buried. In the end, the seven sovereigns fell, and the heaven and earth were opened.

title: The Unified Human Civilization & Celestial Envoys
dateDisplay: ~5,500 Years Ago • Golden Age of Mortals
summary: Humanity prospers across all of Teyvat as a single civilization guided directly by Seelie envoys from Celestia.
description: After terraforming the realm, Phanes created mortals. Humanity flourished across the continent under a single language and architectural style, remnants of which still exist in subterranean ruins across all nations. Wise and beautiful celestial envoys—the Seelie—walked openly among humanity, offering divine revelations directly from the heavens in an age of prosperity without war.

sources.title: Tiara of Frost / Circlet Artifacts
sources.quote: The envoys of the gods walked among benevolent humanity then, and the communication between heaven and earth was unobstructed.

sources.title: A Thousand Floating Dreams Weapon Lore
sources.quote: Long, long ago, the great and ancient spirits walked the surface alongside the mortals.

title: Invasion of the Second Who Came & Shattered Skies
dateDisplay: ~5,000 Years Ago • The Funerary Year
summary: A second extraterrestrial throne strikes Teyvat, causing a celestial war that shatters the Unified Civilization.
description: The peace of the world ended abruptly when 'The Second Who Came' descended through the sky. A catastrophic war broke out between the heavens and the invader. The celestial firmament cracked, the continental plates shifted violently, and direct communication between Celestia and humanity was permanently severed.

sources.title: Before Sun and Moon: The Funerary Year
sources.quote: The second throne of the heavens came, and war opened, as did the heavens and the earth. Then, darkness descended upon the lands.

sources.title: Genshin Impact Wiki: Second Who Came

title: The Sinking of Byakuyakoku (Enkanomiya)
dateDisplay: ~5,000 Years Ago • Abyssal Plunge of Byakuyakoku
summary: During the War of Funerary Flame, an entire realm collapses beneath the ocean into the Dark Abyssal depths.
description: As the war shook heaven and earth, the mortal land of Byakuyakoku broke away from the surface and plummeted into the deep ocean cavern known today as Enkanomiya. Trapped in perpetual darkness and preyed upon by ferocious Bathysmal Vishaps, the stranded humans cried out to heaven, but only the Shade of Time, Istaroth, did not abandon them.

tags.spoilerLevel: From Dusk to Dawn in Byakuyakoku

sources.title: Before Sun and Moon: The Third Year of Darkness
sources.quote: The land was sunk into the waters. The people cried out to heaven, but only the God of Time listened to their desperate pleas.

title: The Fall and Curse of the Seelie Race
dateDisplay: ~4,900 Years Ago • The Seelie Degradation
summary: Following the War of Funerary Flame and a forbidden union with an outlander, the Seelie race is cursed to devolve into mindless wisps.
description: After the disaster, a Seelie maiden fell in love with an outlander traveler. Celestia placed a cruel curse upon the entire Seelie species: should they ever fall in love with humanity, they would lose their wisdom, beauty, and physical bodies, degrading into the small, mournful guiding wisps that now wander the ruins of Teyvat.

sources.title: Records of Jueyun: Vol. 4
sources.quote: They were cursed to wander the wilderness. If they ever fall in love with mortals, their forms wither and their intellect vanishes.

title: Skyfrost Nail Falls on Sal Vindagnyr (Dragonspine)
dateDisplay: ~4,800 Years Ago • Celestial Judgment of Sal Vindagnyr
summary: A Celestial Divine Nail plummets from the heavens, freezing the paradise mountain of Sal Vindagnyr into Dragonspine.
description: High upon what is now Dragonspine once stood Sal Vindagnyr, a green, lush mountain kingdom centered on a sacred silver-white Irminsul tree. Suspected of hubris or seeking forbidden secrets, the civilization was obliterated when a Celestial Nail descended from the heavens. The impact shattered the peak, frosted the entire region in perpetual blizzards, and froze its inhabitants to extinction.

sources.title: Blizzard Strayer Artifact Set
sources.quote: When the nail from the heavens broke the mountain into shards, the girl picked a branch from the frost-covered tree, but the cold would not relent.

sources.title: Snow-Tombed Starsilver Lore
sources.quote: When the heavens' pillars descended, the lush mountain was swallowed by endless howling ice and snow.

title: Celestial Nail Impacts The Chasm
dateDisplay: ~4,500 Years Ago • Shattering of the Liyue Bedrock
summary: A Celestial Divine Nail crashes into western Liyue, creating the subterranean depths of The Chasm.
description: A Divine Nail plummeted from Celestia into the mineral-rich mountains of western Liyue. The colossal kinetic force created the inverted crater of The Chasm, driving out the ancient abyssal darkness beneath and warping the bedrock into twisting luminescent crystalline caverns.

sources.title: Tenacity of the Millelith Artifact Set
sources.quote: In ancient times, a star fell from the sky into the vast wastelands to the west, transforming the earth into a deep abyss.

title: The Jade Ancestors Settle in Chenyu Vale
dateDisplay: ~4,000 Years Ago • Settlement of Chenyu Vale
summary: Herbalists and Adepti settle the misty terraced valleys of Chenyu Vale, carving sacred Rainjade altars.
description: Long before the formal establishment of Liyue Harbor, mortal clans fled regional divine conflicts and settled in the misty green mountains of Chenyu Vale. Guided by the Adepti Fujin, Lingyuan, and the Mountain Lord, they established sacred rites of Spirit Carp and crafted the immortal Rainjade altars to regulate the waterways.

sources.title: Fragment of Harmonious Whimsy Artifact Set
sources.quote: The ancestors of Chenyu carved jade to pacify the churning river waters and offer tribute to the mountains.

title: The Tripartite Alliance of Sumeru (Ay-Khanoum)
dateDisplay: ~3,800 Years Ago • City of Ay-Khanoum
summary: King Deshret, the Goddess of Flowers, and Greater Lord Rukkhadevata unite to build the utopia of Ay-Khanoum.
description: In the golden sands and lush oases of Sumeru, three benevolent divinities formed a sacred pact of friendship: King Deshret (Amon), Nabu Malikata (the Goddess of Flowers), and Greater Lord Rukkhadevata. Together they founded Ay-Khanoum ('City of the Moon Maiden'), blending wisdom, dreams, and life into an unprecedented age of desert prosperity.

sources.title: The Tale of Shiruyeh and Shirin
sources.quote: Three gods shared their thrones upon the oasis: the Lord of the Desert, the Mistress of Flowers, and the Avatar of the Tree.

sources.title: Flower of Paradise Lost Artifact Set
sources.quote: The three friends raised Ay-Khanoum, where mortals and spirits lived side by side.

title: The Sacrifice of Nabu Malikata
dateDisplay: ~3,500 Years Ago • The Passing of Nabu Malikata
summary: Nabu Malikata willingly perishes to unlock forbidden knowledge for King Deshret, sowing the seeds of desert tragedy.
description: Seeking to help King Deshret overcome the immutable rules of the Heavenly Principles, Nabu Malikata willingly sacrificed her physical life. Her death caused Padisarahs to bloom across the desert, but her passing broke King Deshret's heart, driving him into an obsessive quest to reconstruct her mind and conquer mortality itself through forbidden abyssal knowledge.

sources.title: Oasis Garden's Reminiscence
sources.quote: The Goddess of Flowers chose to perish so that the Lord of Sand might look upon the sky unblinded.

title: God King Remus & The High Symphony of Remuria
dateDisplay: ~3,500 Years Ago • Era of Remuria
summary: God King Remus unifies ancient Fontaine into the empire of Remuria using magical golden ichor and music.
description: In the waters of ancient Fontaine, God King Remus founded the grand civilization of Remuria upon the massive ship Fortuna. Remus sought to defy the prophesied doom of the Primordial Sea by transmuting mortal souls into phobos—a golden symphony composed into stone and brass golems—before internal corruption and hubris brought Remuria's cataclysmic sinking.

tags.spoilerLevel: Sea of Bygone Eras World Quest

sources.title: The History of the Decline and Fall of Remuria
sources.quote: King Remus came aboard Fortuna, playing the golden harp. He gathered all peoples under his great symphony.

title: The Tyranny and Fall of Gurabad
dateDisplay: ~3,000 Years Ago • The Jinni Curse of Gurabad
summary: Ormazd founds Gurabad with the Jinni Liloupar, but betrayal and blood lead to the kingdom's annihilation.
description: Following Ay-Khanoum's decline, the mortal shepherd Ormazd rose to power in Gurabad with the aid of the Jinni Liloupar. Ormazd became a cruel tyrant, enslaving the desert folk. Enraged, Liloupar wove a three-generation curse of fratricide and plague that collapsed Gurabad into ruins and sand.

sources.title: The Tomb of Caroses / The Scroll of Streaming Song
sources.quote: Liloupar's vengeance tore through three generations of royalty until the great walls of Gurabad choked on dust.

title: Morax and Guizhong Establish the Guili Assembly
dateDisplay: ~3,700 Years Ago • Dawn of the Archon War
summary: Morax and Guizhong unite their peoples upon the fertile plains of Liyue, establishing the Guili Assembly.
description: Around 3,700 years ago, Morax (God of Geo) and Guizhong (God of Dust) allied their followers on the vast fertile plains north of Mt. Tianheng. Combining their names into 'Guili', Guizhong guided mortals in engineering, agriculture, and moral code, while Morax shielded the assembly with stone and jade.

sources.title: Stone Tablet Compilations: Vol. 1
sources.quote: Guizhong and Morax were allies. They gathered the people upon the plains, giving it the name Guili from their combined names.

sources.title: Memory of Dust Weapon Lore
sources.quote: 'This is the mark of our pledge, and it is also my challenge to you. All my wisdom is hidden within this stone dumbbell.'

title: The Fall of Guizhong & Founding of Liyue Harbor
dateDisplay: ~3,700 Years Ago • Tragedy on Guili Plains
summary: Guizhong perishes during a fierce assault on the Guili Plains; Morax guides the survivors to found Liyue Harbor.
description: During the escalating clashes of the Archon War, black dust and rival gods unleashed a catastrophic flood across the Guili Plains. Guizhong fell in battle amidst the Glaze Lilies. Grieving the loss of his dearest companion, Morax led the surviving mortals south past Mt. Tianheng to the sea, where they laid the first foundations of Liyue Harbor.

sources.title: Customs of Liyue: Vol. 2
sources.quote: Guizhong perished amidst the glaze lilies. The Geo Archon led the people south of Mt. Tianheng, founding the port city of Liyue.

title: The Rebellion in Old Mondstadt & Barbatos' Ascension
dateDisplay: ~2,600 Years Ago • Song of Freedom in Old Mondstadt
summary: Mortals and a wind sprite overthrow Decarabian in Old Mondstadt; Barbatos ascends as the Anemo Archon.
description: In Old Mondstadt (Stormterror's Lair), the God of Storms Decarabian confined his people within an impenetrable hurricane barrier. A nameless boy bard, the hunter Amos, the knight Gunnhildr, and a tiny wind sprite united in rebellion. Decarabian was slain, the boy perished in the battle, and the wind sprite took the boy's form, ascending as Barbatos, the Anemo Archon.

sources.title: Biography of Gunnhildr
sources.quote: A nameless wind spirit heard the cries of the people... from the songs of the bard arose the breeze that broke the howling walls of Decarabian.

sources.title: Amos' Bow Weapon Lore
sources.quote: Even at the very moment her arrow pierced his heart, the fierce winds did not diminish her longing for true freedom.

title: Andrius Yields the Anemo Throne to Barbatos
dateDisplay: ~2,600 Years Ago • The Wolf King's Choice
summary: The Wolf of the North realizes his frozen blizzards cannot nourish mortal life and yields the Divine Throne.
description: Andrius (Lupus Boreas), the mighty Wolf King of the North, realized that his freezing blizzards only brought hardship to human beings. Believing himself incapable of nurturing mortal civilization, he surrendered his chance at the Anemo Archon throne and chose to let his physical body perish, allowing his spirit to remain as a guardian of Wolvendom.

sources.title: Breeze Amidst the Forest: Vol. 1
sources.quote: Andrius believed that his biting cold could only snuff out human lives. Therefore, he chose to let his power flow into the earth.

title: Orobashi Rescues Enkanomiya and Raises Watatsumi
dateDisplay: ~2,200 Years Ago • Orobashi Raises Watatsumi Island
summary: The Great Serpent Orobashi flees the Archon War, encounters Enkanomiya, and lifts its people up to Watatsumi Island.
description: Fleeing the wrath of the golden god Morax during the Archon War, the great serpent Orobashi fell into the depths of Enkanomiya. Touched by the prayers of the desperate subterranean humans, Orobashi broke coral branches from his body to illuminate their darkness, slew the Dragonheir vishaps, and carried the people to the surface, raising Watatsumi Island from the sea.

sources.title: The Narukami Trail: Vol. 1
sources.quote: The great serpent fled to the bottom of the ocean. There, he took pity on the children of the dark and brought them up to the surface.

title: Liberation of Tollan & First Pyro Archon Xbalanque
dateDisplay: ~2,000 Years Ago • Liberation of Tollan & First Pyro Archon
summary: Xbalanque slays the dragon tyrant Xiuhcoatl at Tollan, establishing the rules of the Pyro Archon and the Ode of Resurrection.
description: Two thousand years ago, during the tumultuous conflicts of the Archon War, the human hero Xbalanque led mortal warriors against the oppressive dragon lord Xiuhcoatl in the Sacred City of Tollan. Slaying Xiuhcoatl and taking one of his eyes in an oath of peace, Xbalanque ascended as the first Pyro Archon. With the aid of Ronova, the Shade of Death, he instituted the Sacred Flame, the Pilgrimage, and the Ode of Resurrection so that mortal humans could inherit the divine throne.

sources.title: Talking Stick Weapon Lore
sources.quote: Xbalanque buried the ancient dragon lord in the city of gold, and lit the first Sacred Flame for mortals.

sources.title: Natlan World Quest: Tale of Dreams Plucked From Fire
sources.quote: With the Shade of Death's blessing, Xbalanque established the rules of the Pyro Archon, ensuring the flame would never be extinguished.

title: Raiden Ei Slays Orobashi at Yashiori Island
dateDisplay: ~2,000 Years Ago • Duel at Yashiori Island
summary: Orobashi is coerced by Celestia into invading Yashiori; Raiden Ei executes the serpent with the Musou no Hitotachi.
description: Having learned the forbidden history of the world in *Before Sun and Moon*, Orobashi was sentenced to death by Celestia. To save his people from celestial annihilation, Orobashi sacrificed himself by invading Yashiori Island. Raiden Ei met him in battle and cleaved both the serpent god and the entire island in two with a single strike of the Musou no Hitotachi, creating the Musoujin Gorge.

sources.title: Emblem of Severed Fate Artifact Set
sources.quote: That slash split the serpent god in two, cut the island asunder, and severed the life of the General of the Tengu.

sources.title: Before Sun and Moon
sources.quote: For reading this book, the great serpent was sentenced to death by heaven.

title: King Deshret's Forbidden Knowledge Sacrifice
dateDisplay: ~2,000 Years Ago • Close of the Archon War in Sumeru
summary: Forbidden knowledge corrupts King Deshret's empire; Deshret sacrifices himself while Rukkhadevata shrinks her form.
description: King Deshret unleashed forbidden knowledge from the dark cosmos in an attempt to create an eternal world without divine oppression. The corruption spread like a contagion, afflicting the populace with Eleazar and releasing Withering Zones. King Deshret sacrificed himself to contain the catastrophe, while Greater Lord Rukkhadevata exhausted her divine power cleansing Irminsul, regressing into the form of a small child and claiming the Dendro divine seat.

tags.spoilerLevel: Archon Quest Chapter III: Act IV

sources.title: Archon Quest Chapter III: Act IV - King Deshret and the Three Magi
sources.quote: 'King Deshret chose to sacrifice himself to seal away the forbidden knowledge... and the Greater Lord expended her power, shrinking into the form of a child.'

title: Fall of Remuria & Egeria's Ascension
dateDisplay: ~2,000 Years Ago • Sinking of Remuria & Egeria's Ascension
summary: Remuria collapses beneath the waves; Egeria is freed from the Primordial Sea and becomes the Hydro Archon.
description: The Dragon of Water Scylla and rebelling vishaps attacked Remuria's capital. Phobos collapsed into madness, and Remuria sank into the abyss. Remus gave up his life, and Egeria was summoned from the depths of the Primordial Sea by Celestia to assume the Hydro Archon throne, forgiving the sins of mortal survivors and creating the modern nation of Fontaine.

tags.spoilerLevel: Sea of Bygone Eras World Quest

sources.title: The History of the Decline and Fall of Remuria: Vol. 3
sources.quote: The waters engulfed the golden city. From the tears of the sorrowful depths, the Lord of All Waters arose to guide the people.

title: Vennessa's Rebellion & Founding of Knights of Favonius
dateDisplay: ~1,000 Years Ago • Vennessa's Rebellion
summary: The gladiator slave Vennessa and Barbatos overthrow the corrupt Aristocracy, establishing the Knights of Favonius.
description: A thousand years ago, Mondstadt was choked by the tyranny of the Lawrence Clan and the corrupt aristocracy. The red-haired gladiator slave Vennessa challenged Lord Lawrence. With the timely aid of Barbatos and the dragon Dvalin, Vennessa liberated the city, abolished human slavery, and founded the Knights of Favonius and the Church of Favonius.

tags.spoilerLevel: Genshin Impact Manga / Venti Story Quest

sources.title: Biography of Gunnhildr
sources.quote: A thousand years ago, the brave warrior Vennessa rose up against the corrupt aristocracy, and freedom returned to the City of the Wind.

sources.title: Genshin Impact Official Manga: Prologue
sources.quote: 'Mondstadt's wind belongs to everyone! Not just the nobles who claim to own it.'

title: Vennessa Ascends to Celestia as the Falcon of the West
dateDisplay: ~1,000 Years Ago • Ascension of the Falcon of the West
summary: At the end of her life, Vennessa ascends to Celestia at Windrise, becoming one of the Four Winds.
description: After governing Mondstadt in peace as its first Dandelion Knight, Vennessa took her final journey to Windrise. In full view of the people, she ascended to Celestia, leaving behind a sapling that grew into the monumental oak tree seen today. She transformed into the Falcon of the West, eternally watching over Mondstadt.

sources.title: Breeze Amidst the Forest: Vol. 2
sources.quote: At Windrise, the maiden ascended to the heavens, taking the form of a great falcon to guard the realm forevermore.

title: The Legend and Ascension of Master Guhua
dateDisplay: ~800 Years Ago • The Ascension of Master Guhua
summary: The martial artist Guhua masters the sword and polearm, ascending to the heavens in a flash of purple light.
description: During Liyue's mortal era, a legendary hero named Guhua mastered the twin martial arts of the Rain Cutter and the Light Piercer. Walking the mortal path with unmatched righteousness and chivalry, he achieved enlightenment at Kingfisher's Peak, ascending to the celestial realm in a beam of violet dawn light and establishing the Guhua Clan.

sources.title: Records of the Gallant: Vol. 1
sources.quote: Master Guhua traversed the land with a righteous heart. When his martial art reached perfection, he ascended into the purple dawn.

title: The Cataclysm: Rhinedottir & The Five Sinners
dateDisplay: 500 Years Ago • The Eclipse Dynasty Falls
summary: Khaenri'ah's alchemists breach the abyss; dark monsters pour out across the seven nations.
description: Five centuries ago, the godless underground kingdom of Khaenri'ah collapsed into catastrophic madness. Led by Rhinedottir (Gold) and the Five Sinners, the alchemical Art of Khemia breached abyssal boundaries, birthing terrifying synthetic monsters such as Durin, Elynas, and legions of Rifthounds that surged into every nation of Teyvat.

sources.title: Breeze Amidst the Forest: Vol. 2
sources.quote: Five hundred years ago, disaster descended upon the land. The dark dragon Durin was born of corrupted alchemy.

sources.title: Shadow of the Errant Stalker Weapon Lore
sources.quote: The black sun fell, and the five sinners divided the power of the abyss among themselves.

title: Destruction of Khaenri'ah & The Curse of Wilderness
dateDisplay: 500 Years Ago • Celestial Retribution & The Curse
summary: Celestia destroys Khaenri'ah; its pureblood mortals are cursed with immortality and half-bloods into hilichurls.
description: The Heavenly Principles summoned the Seven Archons directly to Khaenri'ah to eradicate the Abyssal corruption. The subterranean nation was obliterated by divine pillars and cubes of red light. Celestia laid a terrible curse upon its citizens: pureblood Khaenri'ahns were doomed to eternal immortality watching their minds erode, while those of foreign blood were warped into monstrous hilichurls.

tags.spoilerLevel: Archon Quest: Requiem of the Echoing Depths / Caribert

sources.title: Archon Quest Chapter II: Act IV - Requiem of the Echoing Depths
sources.quote: 'The curse of immortality was not a blessing, but the cruelest torment. For five hundred years, my flesh has eroded while my soul cannot die.'

title: The Fall of Durin upon Dragonspine
dateDisplay: 500 Years Ago • Fall of Durin upon Dragonspine
summary: The corrupted shadow dragon Durin invades Mondstadt; Barbatos and Dvalin defeat it over Dragonspine.
description: During the Cataclysm, Rhinedottir's dark dragon Durin flew over Mondstadt, threatening total annihilation. Barbatos awakened from his slumber and summoned the dragon Dvalin (Stormterror). After an apocalyptic aerial battle in the clouds, Dvalin tore Durin's throat, sending the beast crashing onto the snowy slopes of Dragonspine, where its corrupted red heart still beats within Wyrmrest Valley.

tags.spoilerLevel: The Chalk Prince and the Dragon / Prologue

sources.title: Breeze Amidst the Forest: Vol. 2 - Ballad of Durin
sources.quote: Dvalin spread six wings and tore through the clouds, biting through the neck of the dark dragon. The shadow dragon crashed into the snow of the silver mountain.

title: Bosacius and Boyang Seal the Abyssal Breach in The Chasm
dateDisplay: 500 Years Ago • The Bedrock Sacrifice in The Chasm
summary: The Yaksha Bosacius and Millelith soldier Boyang trap themselves inside the Fantastic Compass to seal the Abyss.
description: Abyssal monsters poured from the bottom of The Chasm into Liyue. Morax deployed the Millelith and the Yakshas. The madness-afflicted Electro Yaksha Bosacius and the Millelith sorcerer Boyang lured the dark horde into the deepest cavern, activating the Fantastic Compass to seal the rift from within, sacrificing their lives so that Liyue's surface would remain safe.

sources.title: Archon Quest Interlude Chapter: Act II - Perilous Trail
sources.quote: 'Boyang, do you miss home?' 'I do... but look, the monsters can no longer escape. Our people are safe.'

title: The Sacrifices of Makoto, Rukkhadevata & Egeria
dateDisplay: 500 Years Ago • Sacrifices of Makoto, Rukkhadevata & Egeria
summary: Three Archons perish in the Cataclysm, altering the divine thrones of Inazuma, Sumeru, and Fontaine forever.
description: The Cataclysm exacted a brutal toll on the Seven. In Khaenri'ah, Raiden Makoto was fatally wounded, leaving her mourning twin Ei to forge the Shogun puppet. In Sumeru, Greater Lord Rukkhadevata purged forbidden knowledge from Irminsul, creating Nahida before expending herself. In Fontaine's Tunigi Hollow, Egeria dissolved her body into the Amrita nectar to cleanse the abyssal filth, giving birth to the Pari.

sources.title: Archon Quest Chapter III: Act V - Where the Boat of Consciousness Crafts
sources.quote: 'Let the world completely forget me.' With these words, the avatar of Irminsul cleansed the world's memory.

sources.title: Vourukasha's Glow Artifact Set
sources.quote: The former Lord of the Amrita dissolved into sweet waters to wash away the black mud of the abyss.

sources.title: Genshin Impact Wiki: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata

title: Chlothar Alberich Founds the Abyss Order
dateDisplay: ~499 Years Ago • The Miracle of the Sinner
summary: Chlothar Alberich encounters the Sinner in a Sumeru cavern and founds the Abyss Order to avenge Khaenri'ah.
description: Tormented by his half-blood son Caribert's transformation into a hilichurl, the Khaenri'ahn noble Chlothar Alberich wandered Sumeru's Avidya forest. Guided by the Traveler's sibling, Chlothar encountered a mysterious floating crystal radiating dark divinity—the Sinner Vedrfolnir. Witnessing a blasphemous miracle, Chlothar abandoned all gods and proclaimed the founding of the Abyss Order.

tags.spoilerLevel: Archon Quest Chapter III: Act VI - Caribert

sources.title: Archon Quest Chapter III: Act VI - Caribert
sources.quote: 'I shall be the herald of the abyss. The gods shall know the fury of those they have discarded!'

title: Focalors Divides Her Divinity & Furina's Masquerade Begins
dateDisplay: 499 Years Ago • Masquerade of the Oratrice & Furina
summary: To deceive the Heavenly Principles and subvert the prophecy of Fontaine, Focalors secludes her divinity within the Oratrice and tasks Furina with a 500-year performance.
description: Inheriting the Hydro Archon throne after Egeria's fall, Focalors uncovered the inescapable prophecy that all Fontainians would dissolve. To subvert Celestia, Focalors divided her divinity from her human body, creating Furina to act as the immortal Archon in public while accumulating Indemnitium in the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale for nearly five centuries to execute the divine throne itself.

tags.spoilerLevel: Archon Quest Chapter IV: Act V - Masquerade of the Guilty

sources.title: Archon Quest Chapter IV: Act V - Masquerade of the Guilty
sources.quote: 'For five hundred years, she lived only to play this role... A human body bearing the torment of gods, all to deceive the Heavenly Principles.'

title: Rosalyne Becomes the Crimson Witch of Flame
dateDisplay: ~490 Years Ago • The Crimson Witch of Flame
summary: Following Rostam's death in the Cataclysm, Rosalyne burns her mortal body to become the Crimson Witch, later joining the Fatui as La Signora.
description: Returning from her studies at the Sumeru Akademiya to find Mondstadt devastated and her beloved Rostam slain by abyssal monsters, Rosalyne-Kruzchka Lohefalter was consumed by grief. She burned away her mortal flesh with liquid fire to incinerate every monster in Teyvat as the Crimson Witch of Flame, before Pierro found her and recruited her as the Eighth Fatui Harbinger, La Signora.

tags.spoilerLevel: Crimson Witch of Flames / Inazuma Archon Quest

sources.title: Crimson Witch of Flames Artifact Set
sources.quote: She poured liquid fire into her veins. Long before the people feared her as a monster, she had wept all her tears upon the grave of her beloved.

title: Neuvillette Appointed Iudex of Fontaine
dateDisplay: ~400 Years Ago • Neuvillette Appointed Iudex of Fontaine
summary: The reincarnated Hydro Sovereign Neuvillette arrives in the Court of Fontaine, assuming office as the nation's Chief Justice.
description: Invited by Focalors via an enigmatic letter, Neuvillette—the newly reincarnated Hydro Dragon Sovereign in human form—entered mortal society and accepted the post of Iudex (Chief Justice) at the Palais Mermonia. Over four centuries, Neuvillette oversaw the legal system, championed the integration of Melusines into Fontaine society, and grew to understand human emotional fragility.

sources.title: Neuvillette - Character Story 4
sources.quote: Four hundred years ago, upon the invitation of the Hydro Archon, the newly awakened dragon sovereign assumed the seat of the Chief Justice.

title: The Tatarasuna Smelter Incident & Scaramouche's Betrayal
dateDisplay: ~400 Years Ago • Tragedy of the Tatarasuna Smelter
summary: Fatui Harbinger Dottore sabotages the Mikage Furnace, driving the puppet Kabukimono into despair.
description: On Inazuma's island of Kannazuka, the wandering puppet created by Ei—known as Kabukimono—lived peacefully among the craftsmen of Tatarasuna. Infiltrating the smelter under the guise of an engineer, the Fatui Harbinger Il Dottore sabotaged the furnace with black jade, murdered Niwa, and tricked the puppet into believing he had been abandoned, setting him on the path to becoming Scaramouche.

tags.spoilerLevel: Archon Quest Interlude: Inversion of Genesis

sources.title: Husk of Opulent Dreams Artifact Set
sources.quote: He thought that he had found a home among mortals, until the black smoke choked the smelter and betrayal took his heart.

title: Scaramouche's Vengeance & Fall of the Raiden Gokaden
dateDisplay: ~100 Years Ago • Fall of the Raiden Gokaden
summary: Seeking vengeance against the bladesmiths of Inazuma, Scaramouche sabotages the Raiden Gokaden forging clans.
description: Approximately a century ago, the vengeful puppet Kunikuzushi orchestrated the systematic destruction of Inazuma's five supreme sword-forging traditions (the Raiden Gokaden). Tampering with the Shogunate's sacred blueprints, he brought about the execution and flight of the master smiths of the Isshin, Hyakume, and Senju arts, leaving only the Kaedehara and Kamisato clans clinging to survival.

tags.spoilerLevel: Hues of the Violet Garden Event Quest

sources.title: Kagotsurube Isshin Weapon Lore
sources.quote: The bladesmith clans withered one after another under the shadow of an unknown puppeteer's wrath.

sources.title: Hues of the Violet Garden: The Blackier Leaf
sources.quote: A century ago, Kunikuzushi altered the sacred diagram to avenge his perceived betrayal in Tatarasuna.

title: The Crepus Delusion Incident & Diluc's Departure
dateDisplay: 4 Years Ago • Incident of Crepus & Ursa the Drake
summary: Crepus dies using a Delusion against Ursa the Drake; Dottore intervenes; Diluc resigns from the Knights of Favonius.
description: Four years ago on Diluc's eighteenth birthday, the monster Ursa the Drake attacked Master Crepus' transport caravan outside Mondstadt. Crepus repelled the beast by tapping into a dark Fatui Delusion, but the backlash mortally wounded him. When Grand Inspector Eroch ordered the sacrifice covered up to preserve the Knights' reputation, Diluc resigned in fury, setting out on a three-year vigil through the seven nations to hunt the Fatui.

tags.spoilerLevel: Genshin Impact Manga / Diluc Character Story 4

sources.title: Diluc - Character Story 4
sources.quote: On that rainy day four years ago, Crepus unleashed a forbidden power to protect his son, dying in Diluc's arms.

sources.title: Genshin Impact Official Manga: Chapter 1
sources.quote: The monster was driven off, but the black fire had already consumed his soul.

title: The Outlander Awakens: Starfell Beach
dateDisplay: Present Day (0 YA) • The Journey Across Teyvat Begins
summary: Separated from their twin for five hundred years, the Traveler awakens on a Mondstadt beach and rescues Paimon.
description: Sealed away by the Sustainer of Heavenly Principles during their escape from the Cataclysm 500 years prior, the Traveler awakens alone on the pristine shores of Starfell Beach in Mondstadt. After fishing up the floating fairy Paimon from the sea, the two embark on an epic odyssey across the Seven Nations to meet the Seven Archons, uncover the secrets of Celestia, and reunite with their lost sibling.

sources.title: Archon Quest Prologue: Act I - The Outlander Who Caught the Wind
sources.quote: 'So, what you're telling me is that you fell into this world from another star, and then an unknown god took your twin away?'
